criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: S1 is a real cover, S7 the most intelligent frame. S6 shows a nodule in all three cases so it reads 3 in 3 at feed size, S5 mostly empty wood grain with floating pills and a diagonal plate, S8 stock avatar figures and blocky bark, S3 fake glyph text.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: Reads as one post, palette and type hold, the glass lung returns on 1, 6 and 9, gold keeps one meaning. S8 sits outside the glass and studio vocabulary.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces. Primary sources, vendor 80 percent kept off, patient story attributed, no frame says the AI flagged her nodule. S7 states the age range without the smoking criteria; no surface says the release gives no after AI timing.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who and the surprise are clear and S9 gives an action. No place named beyond the institution and no deadline.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns the swipe and S9 closes on an action, but the turn is pre-spent on the cover and in the caption, and S4 and S5 share a beat.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and on register, close to the release, no Texas texture, the caption's closing question is flat.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Fresh topic and approach, but the third clinical AI deck in seven days.

one_sentence_fix: Rebuild S6 so the picture states the share it claims, and take the two thirds figure out of S1's body so the turn lands on S6.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: All three lung cases carry a gold nodule, so it reads 3 of 3 and nothing tells the screening scan from the incidental ones.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Give the two nodule cases distinct non screening scan shapes so the share reads without the text.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Mostly empty wood grain, pills float in a dead middle third, type on a diagonal purple plate.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Pull the camera down and in so the rail and hands fill the upper two thirds, seat each pill on its object, seat the headline in the desk's shadow.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Stock avatar figures from behind and a blocky trunk, out of the deck's material vocabulary.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Bring the figures and ground into the deck's material language.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Fake glyph text breaks up close and the flat stack has no single focal subject.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Greeked bars, a low tilted camera, the gold strip lifting off the top sheet.
